title: KSI Auto Parts
description:
[distribution] KSI Auto Parts — a PE-backed aftermarket auto body parts distributor with 24 locations across 16 US states, ~$369M annualised revenue, and $307M in TwinBrook Capital PE debt — suffered a data exfiltration from six internal servers totalling approximately 345 GB.

The exposed material includes:

<redacted>
<redacted>
<redacted>
Complete financial records: consolidated P&L, balance sheets, cash flow statements (2025–2026), TwinBrook $307M loan summaries, Credit Agreement with all amendments, entity valuation, and 8 years of audit workpapers.
4.8 GB of product catalog databases and 3.4 GB of per-location inventory/pricing data.
M&A documentation: McLaren, RTB, and Express Parts ($57.5M) acquisition files, purchase agreements, and Investcorp PE communications.
